title: Small Totem Blue
description: A Small Minimalistic blue themed totem
body:
**Small Blue Totem**

A compact Minecraft totem texture pack featuring a smaller totem in hand with blue eyes. Clean, minimal design that keeps the classic feel while adding a cool blue accent.

**Features**
- Smaller totem size for a more subtle look in first-person view
- Blue eyes
- Lightweight & FPS-friendly — no performance impact

Drop it in your resourcepacks folder, enable it, and enjoy!
